text:
maria: Heads up — our GitOps pipeline (flux) is failing to apply the v2 model-serving helm release in eu-west-1. `flux` shows a HelmRelease reconcile error: resource still in Terminating (CRD/modelruntimes) so Helm can't complete upgrade.
kevin: :eyes: saw a couple of those after the cluster kubelet patch yesterday. CRDs stuck in Terminating often mean finalizers not removed by controller. Any logs from the controller?
ops-bot: [deploy-bot] HelmRelease/model-serving (namespace: ml) upgrade failed: unable to finalize CRD "modelruntimes.inference.redwood.ai": object is being deleted (finalizers:["controller.redwood.ai/cleanup"]) ...
anika: I can ssh into the cluster and check but two things — (1) removing finalizers manually is safe only if controller is dead/absent, (2) make sure there's no data-losing side-effect. Sam, can you confirm whether cleanup finalizer does anything irreversible?
sam: The finalizer triggers PVC cleanup for ephemeral caches — we don't want to accidentally delete those. But if controller is respecting ownerrefs, removing the finalizer to unblock a release is acceptable if we ensure caches are backed up. We have recent snapshot in s3 for that namespace.
kevin: If we need to unblock quickly: `kubectl get crd modelruntimes.inference.redwood.ai -o json` then patch `kubectl patch crd modelruntimes.inference.redwood.ai -p '{"metadata":{"finalizers":[]}}' --type=merge` or patch the individual resource with `kubectl patch <res> -p '{"metadata":{"finalizers":null}}'` — but confirm with Sam first.
maria: I'm going to run `kubectl get` now and paste the CRD/resource names.
---
maria: ```
# from the cluster
kubectl get modelruntimes -n ml
NAME                 AGE    STATUS
model-runtime-abc    12d    Terminating
model-runtime-def    3d     Active
``` 
maria: I'll patch only the Terminating one.
kevin: Also after removing finalizer, run `flux reconcile source git redwood-infra` and `flux reconcile helmrelease ml-model-serving -n ml` to re-trigger the sync.
ops-bot: [action] patch applied by maria at 2026-03-18T14:12:30Z
maria: patched the resource finalizers to []. Flux now progressed and Helm completed the upgrade. :tada: 
anika: Great. For longer-term: we should modify the Helm chart's post-upgrade cleanup job so it sets a soft ownerReference and does not rely on finalizers on CRDs; plus add an integration test that simulates controller crash during upgrade.
kevin: Also open a Terraform ticket to pin the CRD controller deployment to newer rollout strategy (maxUnavailable=0) so it doesn't get killed mid-migration. And add a GitOps check: if a CRD is Terminating, fail fast with a link to runbook.
sam: I'll file the runbook and backup checklist. We should also add a pre-sync hook in our GitOps pipeline that detects CRDs with finalizers and alerts before applying changes.
maria: Filed infra ticket #3421 and PR ready for the Helm chart change. I'll tag you all in review. thanks
kevin: ack.
